scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios-icons && npm run sync:ios-localizations && npm run sync:ios-privacy && tauri ios build

scripts.check:clippy: node scripts/with-private-cargo-cache.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --lib --bins --no-deps -- -D warnings
